name: Witch Doctor Sentry Ward reveals a stealthed enemy (#12534)
contract: #12534 Sentry Ward 674303 'reveals all stealthed and invisible enemies near it'. The ward (NPC 51104,
npc_ascension_witch_doctor) puts 505173 on hostile units within 30 yards. 505173 only has two
SPELL_AURA_DISPEL_IMMUNITY effects for the Stealth (5) and Invisibility (6) dispel types and lacks
SPELL_ATTR1_IMMUNITY_PURGES_EFFECT, so it never removed a stealth or invisibility aura the enemy already had:
a stealthed enemy stayed stealthed. Expected: an enemy that is stealthed with Stealth 1784 when the ward is
placed carries 505173 and loses its stealth within a few seconds.

steps.label: SETUP: a Sentry Ward stands near the Witch Doctor
DISCRIMINATING: the enemy's stealth is removed
